name: get_match_summary
description: Read the captured match identity, replay time, score, available data and model scope.

name: list_players
description: Resolve one or more player identities in the CURRENT replay. Does not search real-world football rosters.

query.description: Name, ID, shirt number or empty string to list the roster.

name: get_player_profiles
description: Read profiles and historical statistics for one or multiple replay players. Respect the source and synthetic labels.

player_ids.description: Player IDs, names or #numbers. Empty array means the selected player. Use list_players to resolve ambiguous names.

name: get_player_match_stats
description: Compare players using current-replay statistics, with explicit passing outcome coverage. Never infer unknown success rates.

player_ids.description: Player IDs, names or #numbers. Empty array means the selected player. Use list_players to resolve ambiguous names.

at_time.description: Time in SECONDS, never minutes. Null means the captured replay time. Statistics are only available at that captured time.

name: get_match_events
description: Read available past replay events. Return times that the user can jump to; never return future events.

start_time.description: Replay time in seconds; null starts at zero.

end_time.description: Replay time in seconds; null ends at the captured time.

player_ids.description: Empty array means all players for this tool.
